reviews.comment: 463/612 is very difficult, but Dr. Loguinov explains the material clearly. Homework is extremely long, includes extra credit, and is done in Winsock, so Mac users need TAMU's free VM, which works but is slow. Exams average around 50–60 or lower, so memorize every slide and practice every problem. He curved grades by 10 points, making an 80 an A.

This has been the most difficult class I have taken at Texas A&M, but it's very rewarding. It will make you a better engineer. Dr. Loguinov cares about his students and is willing to help. He has generous extra credit too.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: It wasn't easy, but it was 1000% worth it. Hardest professor at Texas A&M but in a good way. This course challenged me like no other and I'm a better systems programmer for it. The grading is pretty fair, and the lectures were beyond helpful
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Loguinov may initially come off as a bit closed off / condescending on the surface, but deep down he truly cares about the success and grades of his students. He responds to questions on Homework even when asked at 1-3am, and there's a lot of extra credit. Homeworks take A LOT of time and tests are all FRQs but I learned so much. B is an A btw.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: 313 with Loguinov was an incredibly challenging but enriching experience. The class is taught with the Win32 API, and STL may not be used in later parts of the course. If you are interested in optimization or synchronization, or just want a challenge this class is for you.

He's such a nice guy, and insanely knowledgeable. He uses a Socratic teaching method that pushes you to think and come up with solutions yourself. I didn't truly know how to code until this course, but it's very time-consuming and difficult. Office hours are really helpful.

It is harder to swallow than amoxicillin and way too horrific for a sophomore class. If this is a Pass/Fail class it's perfect - knowledge got, good lecture, but it's not: It's a hard class in TAMU where everyone expects an A. It's hard. It's very hard. You may say that grade points don't matter much, but which class matters in the end anyway?

This class will be very hard and take up a lot of time but its worth it. Loguinov will make you actually learn how to code but it will be hard (especially at first). Lectures aren't bad. Class has 3 exams + 3 Quizzes + 4 Coding homeworks. Go to office hours as Loguinov & TA are both very very helpful. Also responds quick to emails. Best prof imo
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This professor is clearly intelligent, but can be rude and demeaning to people that are asking for more explanations. I frequently would go to the TA as he was more understanding to dumb it down. This prof got offended when I had not read all 27 pages of  his notes for a issue that was not even related to any section of his notes.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: You MUST go to the TA and the professor in this class. This should be your only heavy class this semester. Homeworks take anywhere from 5 - 10 hours and some longer. The TA and professor are helpful if occasionally condescending, and overall this is a great class taught by good people.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Good lectures, explains things well and if he doesn't you can ask questions and he will continue the discussion until you understand it. Helps a lot outside of class on Piazza. Homework is hard but doable, just start early and ask for help when stuck. Good curve at the end of the class too.

Genuinely the best professor I've had at A&M. He's an excellent lecturer, his homeworks are hard, well-defined, and really fun, and he's really helpful during office hours. Dr. Loguinov and the TA gave and took great feedback, and everything was graded quickly and fairly. You have to work for his class, but you'll thank yourself for taking him :)

Dr. Loguinov is undoubtedly one of the best professors I've had at Texas A&M. His understanding and ability to teach the course material is unmatched. The class was engaging, applicable, and incredibly fulfilling; you get what you put into this class. Both Dr. Loguinov and his TA were extremely accessible throughout the course. Highly recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Loguinov clearly cares about his subject and his students.  He will answer all your questions very thoroughly during lecture, and although he lectures fast, the material is all interesting and well explained.  The homeworks are very hard, but doable, and there are lots of office hours opportunities.  Would recommend!!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Well respected and brilliant. He has a deep knowledge of what he's talking about and it shows. Start on the projects early! His class will take up a lot of your time but he gives every opportunity to prove yourself. Put effort in both projects & exams/quizzes. He will reply to your Qs late night if you procrastinate but don't make it a habit.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Louginov is one of the most brilliant people I have ever met. His class is extremely insightful and goes above and beyond non-honors sections. I learned an incredible amount from this man. His homeworks are very challenging, but he will literally spend hours with you debugging if you need help. On top of this he curves an 80% to an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The class has 3 large difficult projects, and tests are hard and can only be passed if you pay attention in lecture. However, Dr. Loguinov is incredibly knowledgeable and helpful. Goes out his way to help in office hrs and is flexible. Best professor I've had. Do note, that his classes require you to use Visual Studio on Windows.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This guy really makes sure you learn the material by literally quizzing you over the tiny things and prove your mastery through the tedious homework assignments. The guy is almost always available for office hours and will literally reply to your email in the middle of the night. Probably the chillest prof I've had but he definitely makes you WORK.
